entries.8c7f0deb1759c45e: Its management philosophy is: 'Contributing to the improvement of living culture and the preservation of the global environment through business centered on housing life.' It aims to realize its purpose of creating a safe, secure and sustainable society. As priority issues, it has set three basic policies: transforming its business portfolio for sustainable growth (raising the sales share of non-housing construction fields and pursuing M&A in new, highly profitable growth fields); focusing sales efforts on growth fields (expanding sales of decarbonization-related products, capturing renovation and reform demand, and developing the non-residential market); and establishing a management foundation that supports stable growth.
